title: Battery Systems Engineer
description:
As a Battery System Engineer at Meta, you will take ownership of the battery pack electrical designs and their integrations to power the state-of-the-art devices developed by Reality Labs. You will work closely with our product engineering teams to define battery requirements, aiming to find optimal options for product volume, weight, and run time. Collaboration with safety, reliability, operations, software, and other cross-functional partners will be essential to integrate the battery into the final system and meet system-level performance metrics. You'll own the backend infrastructure behind our battery validation programs — the pipelines, automation, and analysis tooling that turn raw test data into system-level decisions

* Work with vendors to develop battery packs per Meta’s requirements
* Develop electrical and interconnect architectures for battery management systems
* Develop engineering requirements and specifications, test and validate plans for the manufacturing and characterization of battery packs

* Support hardware integration related to interfacing hardware and connection issues
* Identify system interactions and design factors which impact battery module performance, such as charge time affected by system thermals and battery age, interaction with accessories, and help substantiate product claims on battery runtimes

description:

* Advance Jupiter's leading portfolio of development positions in SPP and PJM from initial desktop screening through pre-construction.
